title: 12-name watchlist · 08 Nov 2026 (Sun) · 08:00 SGT
summary: No distinct material new company development was verified in this incremental window. Earlier Berkshire results and technology stories were not repeated as new research. All 12 November 6 regular-session closes and 72 adjusted-close baselines were freshly verified and remain unchanged. Friday prices predate the Saturday Berkshire earnings release; no earnings-related price reaction is claimed.
coverage_note: Fixed cutoff: 8 November 08:00 SGT (8 November 00:00 UTC). Incremental window: 8 November 03:30–08:00 SGT (7 November 19:30 UTC to 8 November 00:00 UTC), including a 30-minute overlap with the preceding 04:00 SGT edition. Nineteen public queries covered all 12 names, Reuters, official issuer domains and SEC indexing. Seven issuer listings were reread successfully. A fresh SEC-directory batch returned a search-service HTTP 503 and no usable results. Compared 27 retained editions and 129 earlier research records for duplicate events and source URLs. Coverage is partial; no verified update does not establish that no news occurred.
price_basis: USD regular-session closes for 6 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at cutoff. Fresh Yahoo Finance query2 daily series were retrieved 8 Nov 00:04:00–00:04:47 UTC. Exact regularMarketTime quote timestamps are 6 Nov 21:00:00–21:00:02 UTC for eleven names and 21:03:23 UTC for BRK.B, each matching the completed daily bar. Daily changes compare Nov 6 with Nov 5 ordinary closes. Adjusted closes are separate cumulative-return endpoints. Daily-bar timestamps label sessions and are not substituted quote times. Postmarket observations are excluded. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. Prices are saved observations, not live.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes reflecting vendor split and dividend/distribution adjustments. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before Decimal arithmetic; percentages round to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 6 Oct, 4 Sep, 6 Aug, 6 Jul, 5 Jun and 6 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX. No independent reconstruction of dividend-adjustment factors or reinvestment model is claimed.
caveats: Reuters coverage uses partial public search-index text, not an exhaustive live-wire feed. The prior direct Reuters restriction was respected. Retrieval times do not replace original publication times.

Microsoft/Micron direct issuer and Amazon SEC restrictions were respected. Earlier Broadcom issuer failure, incomplete Alphabet/Meta issuer coverage and a search-service SEC batch failure limit this run. Prior SEC inspection timestamps are not presented as fresh checks.

Seven readable issuer listings are not comprehensive company-news feeds. No fresh SEC-directory result was returned, and no exhaustive statement about filings accepted in the incremental window is made. Directory modification metadata, when available in prior reports, is not a filing acceptance timestamp.
Berkshire’s November 7 results were already covered in the 16:00 UTC edition and were excluded as duplicate news. Prior results, risks and catalysts remain available in their original dated report.

An NVIDIA congressional-scrutiny article was indexed at 7 November 21:06:38 UTC, but direct access failed and visible text referred to earlier reporting and a prior briefing request. No distinct new in-window fact was established, so it was excluded. A TSMC foundry-focus response lead also lacked a verified original publication time and was not promoted into new research.

No distinct new narrative research was verified. Empty research arrays preserve earlier reports and do not imply no news or a changed bullish or bearish view. Prior risks and catalysts remain available in dated reports; none are invented to fill this edition.

Yahoo query1 returned HTTP 429; successful fresh chart reads used Yahoo query2. Prices and baselines remain single-vendor observations without independent cross-vendor corroboration. Vendor split/dividend adjustments and reinvestment conventions are not independently reconstructed. Cents-first Decimal arithmetic may differ slightly from unrounded calculations.
